notes.title: LOGA: Unexpected Adventure is coming soon
notes.content:
hello , my name is ibrahim ,i'm an indie developer and i want you to have a look at my upcoming new game ( LOGA: Unexpected Adventure ) , it's a classic run and jump platformer with a really beautiful graphics. 
key features 
- more than 30 stunning levels with no chick-points ( extremely hard ).
- different environment scenes .
- amazing graphics.
- made with only one man.
